Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting theft of solid waste or recyclable materials.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to theft of solid waste or recyclable materials;adding a new section to chapter 9A.56 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of theft of solid waste or recyclablematerials if he or she takes or wrongfully obtains any solid waste orrecyclable materials placed in or immediately adjacent to a bin or acontainer as part of a solid waste or recycling collection programoperated by or under contract with a city, town, county, specialpurpose district, or other governmental entity without the consent ofthe generator or collector of such solid waste or recyclable materialsor the owner or operator of the bin or container. (2) For the purposes of this section, "recyclable materials" and"solid waste" have the same meaning as in RCW 70.95.030 and in additionspecifically include any materials containing "financial information"or "means of identification" as those terms are defined in RCW9.35.005. p. 1 SB 5599 (3) Theft of solid waste or recyclable materials, not amounting totheft in the first degree, theft in the second degree, or theft in thethird degree, is a misdemeanor.
